description: This file defines the AOD_Index class for managing Lucene-based search indexing within SuiteCRM, including methods for document handling, indexing, and module searchability, with deprecated annotations indicating legacy status.

classes.name: AOD_Index
classes.description: A class extending AOD_Index_sugar providing Lucene search index management, document processing, and module searchability within SuiteCRM, marked as deprecated since v7.12.0.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Lucene index with default encoding and analysis settings.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the AOD indexing feature is enabled in the global configuration.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Performs a search query on the Lucene index with the provided query string.

methods.name: optimise
methods.description: Optimizes the Lucene index and updates the last_optimised timestamp.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the singleton AOD_Index bean.

methods.name: getDocumentForRevision
methods.description: Creates a Lucene document from a document revision, supporting multiple MIME types.

methods.name: getDocumentForBean
methods.description: Creates a Lucene document from a SugarBean, adding fields based on object properties and metadata.

methods.name: getBoost
methods.description: Calculates a boost factor for a field based on module and field name.

methods.name: getIndexEvent
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an index event record for tracking indexing operations.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits changes to the Lucene index.

methods.name: isModuleSearchable
methods.description: Determines if a module is searchable based on whitelist, blacklist, and metadata.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes a specific bean by module and ID, updating the search index and index event.

methods.name: getIdForDoc
methods.description: Generates a unique document ID string from module and bean ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes documents from the index matching the given module and bean ID.

methods.name: getLuceneIndex
methods.description: Provides access to the Lucene index, creating or opening it as needed, and configuring index parameters.

methods.name: getIndexableModules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that are searchable based on current configuration and metadata.
